Oracle Fusion Financials 26C: what changed

We track 25 Financials changes in 26C, out of 55 features (our count) in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area. 18 of them are delivered switched on; 7 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Financials 26C What's New · Risk Management (Classic) 26C What's New · Self Service Financials 26C What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (18)

Invoice Import with Supplier Bank Account Details Using Collaboration Messaging Framework

Impact on upgrade: highOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Payables Invoice ProcessingIdea Lab
B2B XML invoices imported into Payables through Collaboration Messaging can now carry the supplier's remit-to bank account number and IBAN, and the invoice installment is paid to that account. If the bank details are left out, Payables falls back to the supplier's primary bank account.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Active Ownership Definition Corrections

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Joint Venture SettlementRedwood Platform
Correct active ownership definitions and rebill affected joint venture transactions. This enhancement eliminates the need to end an active ownership definition and create a new one when ownership changes are required.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

AutoApproved Multitier Intercompany Transaction

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Intercompany Processing
Automatically create intercompany transactions, intercompany invoices, and accounting entries by enabling autoapproval of intercompany transactions. This feature streamlines intercompany processing while maintaining the flexibility to apply manual controls when required.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Consumption Allowance Revenue Recognition

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Revenue Management
Revenue Management now handles allowance-based usage plans from Subscription Management (base allowance, top-ups, rollover and overage) and recognizes revenue for each part under ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Lease Impairments by Representation

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and LeaseIdea Lab
Record lease impairments by capturing impairment percentages and recoverable values separately for primary and secondary representations. Lease administrators can create impairment transactions to write down the right-of-use asset balances for each representation, supporting compliance with varying regulatory or reporting requirements across different jurisdictions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Original Invoice and Credit Memo References for Rebill Invoices

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Receivables Invoice Processing
Use the Rebill Source Transaction field in the Create or Edit Transaction page to associate a rebill invoice with its original invoice, improving traceability during rebill transactions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Receivables Transaction Date as the Fiscal Document Date

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Local Compliance & Reporting
Use the Receivables transaction date as the fiscal document date when generating fiscal documents. This capability supports business scenarios that require issuing a fiscal document with a past date, such as recognizing ICMS tax credits for fixed assets or aligning transaction recognition with the appropriate fiscal document period.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Revenue Contract Realignment

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Revenue Management
Reassign performance obligations between revenue contracts to correct any misidentified contract arrangements, ensuring that obligations originating from multiple orders are accurately consolidated into a single contract.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Service Excellence Continuing Investments

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Performance and Stability
A bundle of small usability, resiliency, performance and security fixes across Financials, for example a new Subledger Accounting source (Prepayment Line Type Code) for prepayment lines. Check Oracle's page for the full list.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Accrued Expense Migration for Exempt Payments

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and LeaseIdea Lab
Import midlife leases with exempt payments by capturing accrued expense migration balances and recognizing exempt payments as expenses evenly over the remaining lease term.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Budget Entry Creation from Revenue for Control Budget

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Planning and Budgeting
Assign a control budget when creating a budget from revenue using the Create Budget Entry from Revenue process. The assignment of a control budget aligns the expense budget scenario to a control budget when importing the budget into both Budgetary Control and General Ledger.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Calculation Calendar for Secondary Representation

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and LeaseIdea Lab
Generate lease amortization schedules and accounting entries for the secondary representation using a calculation calendar that is different from the primary representation.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Carried Interest Payout Processing

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Joint Venture SettlementRedwood Platform
Use carried interest payout processing to configure penalties associated with carried interest agreements. Track the costs, revenue, and balances being carried for non-consenting stakeholders; report on payout balances to the stakeholders; and close agreements after final payout.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Carrier Information in fiscal documents created from Receivables transactions

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Local Compliance & ReportingIdea Lab
Select a carrier for goods fiscal documents created from Receivables transaction and include the carrier’s address, taxpayer ID, and tax registration information in the fiscal document XML.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Lease Migration Balances by Representation

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and LeaseIdea Lab
Capture separate right-of-use asset and accumulated amortization balances for both primary and secondary representations when importing midlife expense leases. Record either gross or net right-of-use asset balances and their corresponding accumulated amortization for each representation during the migration of lease portfolios.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Retirement Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · AssetsAI agent
Retirement Assistant is designed to simplify and streamline the asset retirement process through an intuitive conversational experience that helps fixed asset accountants submit, review, and process retirement activity more efficiently.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

New Dashboard for Reviewing Intra-Role Violations

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsRisk Management (Classic) · Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
A new dashboard for reviewing intra-role access violations: counts of affected roles and users, with drill-down to entitlements, incident paths and violations by algorithm.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

New My Access Requests Dashboard

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsRisk Management (Classic) · Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
Use a pre-built dashboard to monitor requesters’ access request activity and approvals based on the new Advanced Access Requests subject area introduced in 26B.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (7)

Cash Processing Agent for Receipt Processing and Cash Application

Impact on upgrade: mediumOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Cash Processing AgentAI agent Redwood Platform
An AI agent that flags receipt and cash application exceptions and suggests matches, building on Document IO's automated reading of bank files and emailed remittances. Oracle switches the agent on, but nobody can use it until you grant its security access, so Oracle now lists it as setup required.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Additional Satisfaction Event Hold Release Using a REST API

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set up (REST APIs)FinancialsFinancials · Revenue Management
Use the Additional Satisfaction Events REST API to release revenue on performance obligations by recording the completion of customer acceptance, payments, or service provisioning events.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: REST APIs · Oracle source

Attributes for Asset Addition Using ERP Integration REST API

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set up (REST APIs)FinancialsFinancials · Integration & Extensibility
The addAsset service of the ERP Integration REST API now accepts impairment reserve and year-to-date impairment values when you add assets.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: REST APIs · Oracle source

Automated Invoice Generation and Revenue Recognition for Equipment Leases

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-in plus setupFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and LeaseIdea Lab
Automatically generate periodic invoices and recognize revenue for equipment leases. Lease administrators can invoice lessees for rent, service, maintenance, and other charges defined in the lease.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In plus Setup · Oracle source

Brazilian Fiscal Documents in Local Currency for Shipments of Sales Orders in Foreign Currency

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Local Compliance & ReportingIdea Lab
Generate and report fiscal documents in Brazilian Real for shipments associated with sales orders entered in foreign currency. The process automatically converts foreign currency amounts to the local currency and displays the converted values on the Fiscal Document page and in the XML sent to the tax authority.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Budget Adjustment Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Budgetary ControlAI agent
An AI assistant that helps budget office users create budget entries in plain language for control budgets sourced from EPM, fix errors before submitting, and check budgetary control balances. Users need the Budget Adjustment Assistant role.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Cash Processing Agent for Cash Positioning and Improved Liquidity

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · Cash Processing AgentAI agent Redwood Platform
An AI agent that gives cash managers a conversational view of daily liquidity: cash position, bank balances, intraday movements and accounts short of cash. Users need security access set up first.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

All 55 Financials features in Oracle's 26C What's New

Every row of the Feature Summary tables in Oracle's 26C What's New documents for this area, with Oracle's own "Impact to Existing Processes" and "Action to Enable" columns as Oracle states them: 14 on by default, 4 on by default with potential setup, 29 setup required, 6 opt-in, 2 needing another action. Oracle's legend: features whose impact is "None" are not delivered enabled and need steps to use; "Potential Setup" means there is prerequisite or optional configuration to consider.
